content.text:
## Proposal: FE-1175 scope handoff: orient-at-entry execution package

> REQ1, MOD1, AC1, and CH1 are fully linked upstream but have no plan-layer owner. This batch adds a frontier that declares the orient-at-entry delivery boundary, and a scope that assembles the requirement, design unit, and verification machinery into one execution-facing package. After approval, a build agent has everything it needs to implement and verify the feature without re-reading the broader graph.

- __$F1: Orient user at workspace entry__
  
  Delivery boundary for the first-run orientation feature. Done when a user opening a workspace sees the selected spec summary before any deeper elicitation or planning work is presented. Owns the render-selected-spec-entry scope.
- __$SCP1: Render selected-spec entry summary__
  
  Execution-facing handoff package. Implements REQ1 via MOD1; acceptance is gated by AC1 and verified by CH1.
  
  Build contract:
  - Mount MOD1 (selected spec entry summary renderer) as the entry point.
  - The rendered output must satisfy AC1: selected spec appears before any downstream work is shown.
  - CH1 (selected spec entry proof) must pass before the scope is closed.
  - part of __$F1__
    
    > The frontier owns the scope; the scope is the sole handoff unit under this frontier.
  - realizes __REQ1__
    
    > REQ1 is the upstream requirement; the scope is its plan-layer realization.
  - depends on __AC1__
    
    > AC1 is the acceptance criterion that gates scope completion.
  - depends on __CH1__
    
    > CH1 is the oracle check that must pass to verify the scope.

Other new edges:

- __MOD1__ part of __$SCP1__
  
  > MOD1 is the design unit the scope packages for execution.

content.text:
Review set validated and presented. Here's what was proposed and why:

**Two new plan-layer nodes:**
- `$F1` — frontier declaring the orient-at-entry delivery boundary
- `$SCP1` — scope assembling the execution package

**Five edges wiring them to accepted upstream anchors:**

| Edge | Direction | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `$F1` ◂—composition—▸ `$SCP1` | frontier owns scope | one handoff unit per frontier |
| `REQ1` -[realization]→ `$SCP1` | requirement drives scope | canonical intent→plan link |
| `$SCP1` -[composition]→ `MOD1` | scope packages design unit | build target is explicit |
| `AC1` -[dependency]→ `$SCP1` | criterion gates scope | acceptance condition |
| `CH1` -[dependency]→ `$SCP1` | check gates scope | verification machinery |

The external RPC reviewer can approve or reject this batch; no graph mutation has been applied yet.
